name: proyecto-titulacion-anuncios
description: MVP de emisión de anuncios hacia pantallas en red local (WiFi). Monolito modular con MVC, React + TypeScript, Express y PostgreSQL.

scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently -n server,client -c green,white "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: node api.js && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: node api.js && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
